preparation.title: Device preparation: jailbreak iPod touch 4
preparation.subtitle: Ramdisk method · limera1n · no data loss · untethered
preparation.planFailed: The plan could not be created. Make sure the device is still connected.

overview.intro: Pocket Studio guides the device into DFU mode, uses the bootrom exploit to boot a patched SSH ramdisk, then writes the untether and Cydia to the device. The OS is not reflashed and no data is erased.
overview.prerequisitesHint: Confirm each item yourself. They decide whether the flow can finish safely.

batteryAbove50.title: Battery at 50% or more
batteryAbove50.detail: The device reboots several times. A low battery can shut it down mid-flow.

workingButtons.title: Power and Home buttons work
workingButtons.detail: DFU mode depends on both buttons. Broken buttons require a DFU IPSW, which erases the device.

backupCompleted.title: Device data is backed up
backupCompleted.detail: This method keeps your data, but any restore that becomes necessary will erase everything.

stableCable.title: Reliable cable, directly into the computer
stableCable.detail: Avoid hubs and extension cables. Any disconnect interrupts the flow.

computerAwake.title: The computer will not sleep or lock
computerAwake.detail: Disable automatic sleep for now. Sleep drops the USB connection.

dfu.alreadyInDfu: The device is already in DFU mode
dfu.autoAdvance: The flow continues automatically once DFU mode is detected.
dfu.safeToCancel: Nothing has been written yet. Cancelling here is safe.

idle.title: Ready to enter DFU mode
idle.body: After you press Start there is a 3 second countdown. Then follow the animation and timer exactly. The button sequence takes about 16 seconds.

countdown.title: Get your fingers ready
countdown.body: When the countdown ends, hold the top Power button and the Home button at the same time.

holdBoth.title: Hold Power + Home
holdBoth.body: Keep both held until the timer ends. The screen turning off is expected.

holdHome.title: Release Power, keep holding Home
holdHome.body: Release only the top Power button. Keep holding Home until the timer ends.

detecting.title: You can let go. Detecting…
detecting.body: The screen should stay black. Pocket Studio is waiting for the device to reappear in DFU mode.

timeout.title: DFU mode was not detected
timeout.body: The device did not show up in DFU mode. Check the troubleshooting list and try again.

summary.plug: Keep the device connected to the computer.
summary.holdBoth: Hold Power and Home together for 8 seconds.
summary.releasePower: Release Power, keep holding Home for 8 seconds.
summary.blackScreen: A black screen means success. An Apple logo means the buttons were held too long.

appleLogo.title: An Apple logo appeared:
appleLogo.body: Power was held too long or released too late. Let the device finish booting, then start the guide again.

recoveryScreen.title: The "connect to iTunes" screen appeared:
recoveryScreen.body: The device entered Recovery instead of DFU. Hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds to leave it, then try again.

nothing.title: Black screen but nothing detected:
nothing.body: Try another USB port or cable, and avoid hubs.

exitDfu.title: To leave DFU mode:
exitDfu.body: Hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds. The device reboots normally.

execution.cancelHint: The current step can be interrupted safely.
execution.cannotCancelNow: The current step is writing to the device and cannot be interrupted.

keepConnected.title: Do not unplug or shut down
keepConnected.body: The device screen goes black and the device reboots a few times. This is expected.
keepConnected.afterPointOfNoReturn: Writing to the device has started. Interrupting now can leave the device unbootable and require a full restore.

success.title: Jailbreak complete
success.body: The device rebooted and passed verification. Cydia and SSH are available, and the device now meets the Pocket requirements.

failed.title: The flow failed
failed.body: The flow could not be completed.

cancelled.title: Flow cancelled
cancelled.body: The flow stopped at a safe point and the device was not modified. If it is still in DFU mode, hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds to leave it.

result.notRecoverable: This error cannot be fixed by retrying. Follow the steps above first, then start again.
